initial_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. One heritage collection plate. Image1 is the STYLE MASTER only: match its extremely delicate fine black contours, selective detail and generous white space. Other images are SUBJECT GEOMETRY references. Pure WHITE background, BLACK fine lines only, surfaces stay WHITE. No fills, grey shading, hatching, stone grain, cracks everywhere, solid shadows, color, text, lettering, labels, borders, watermarks. Draw the complete ancient stone monument, its old worn edges and actual surviving roof pieces. Exclude every person, barrier, sign, modern protection building, ceiling, window, tree and background. No reconstruction of lost parts. Keep a few major stone joints and a few faint outline motifs from the carved panels; never densely texture or decorate every panel. All inscriptions omitted. Center isolated monument with verticals vertical, balanced margins, apex and base uncut, about80%height. Portrait1024x1536. Subject: the WEST TOWER of TAISHI QUE, Dengfeng, East Han118CE. Image2 is the1907 south-face photograph of this exact tower, showing its complete unprotected ancient body; image3 supplements current stone details. Draw ONE west que only: a broad upright block-built slab tower whose taller main part is at viewer right and low subsidiary projection at left, with worn stone imitations of tiled hip roofs, lower subsidiary eave at left and higher main eave and ridged roof at right. Preserve exact stepped silhouette and broad facade proportions visible in the1907 photo. Remove the man sitting on the eave and infer only the small roof edge he obscures from the intact adjacent roof. Sparse lines for a few carved concentric-ring bands; no readable inscription. This is an East Han stone que, not a pagoda or temple hall. Minimal near-frontal perspective, narrow left side face as in actualphoto.

site_recommendation.name: 太室阙
site_recommendation.sub: 西阙 · 中岳庙神道阙
site_recommendation.lede: 中岳庙前的石阙把汉代屋宇凝固在石头里。母阙与子阙高低相接，残存的石檐和阙铭，仍指向两千年前的祭山礼仪。
facts: 建于东汉元初五年（118），为太室山庙前神道阙。
东西两阙相对，每阙由高低相连的母阙和子阙组成。
石块模拟木构屋顶，阙身留存画像石、乳钉纹及汉代铭文。

basis.supports: 118年、子母阙、石质仿木四阿顶及阙铭。
